group_move_up_tip: Move up. The first matching group in the list wins.
header_help:
Waystones in your inventory, stash and guild stash get badges: the affix count in the top-left corner, map-stat totals in the top-right corner and matching affix groups on the left. Border groups colour the frame of waystones that meet your conditions.

Hover a marked waystone for a breakdown of what it matched.
header_hidden_hint: Press {key} in game to show the badges again.
header_hint: Waystones are marked in your inventory, stash and guild stash.
header_pill_tip: The toggle hotkey (Display tab) hides or shows every badge at once.
header_reset_tip:
Restores badge, colour and overlay defaults.
Border groups, affix groups and the hotkey are kept.
header_reset_confirm: Reset the display settings? Your border groups, affix groups and hotkey stay.
overlay_hotkey_tip:
Press this key in game to hide or show all badges at once,
e.g. to see the game's own highlight while using currency on maps.
Click, then press the key you want (Esc cancels).
overlay_badge_size_tip:
Size of the badge text, relative to the overlay font.
The badges always stay inside their waystone.
overlay_badge_background_tip:
Fill behind every badge.
Lower the alpha to see more of the item art.
overlay_hide_hovered: Hide badges on the hovered waystone
overlay_hide_hovered_tip:
Keeps the waystone under the cursor clean so the game's own
tooltip and highlight stay readable.
overlay_breakdown: Show the breakdown panel on hover
overlay_breakdown_tip:
A panel beside a marked waystone lists its affix count, map stats,
matching affix groups and the border group that coloured it.
count_show_badge_tip:
A badge in the top-left corner with the number of explicit affixes,
shown once the waystone has at least the count below.
count_show_from_tip:
The smallest affix count that gets a badge.
0-2 also marks normal and magic waystones.
count_badge_colour_tip: Text and frame colour of the affix-count badge.
stats_help:
Badges in the top-right corner with the waystone's total of a map stat,
e.g. R65 = 65% more Rarity of Items. Borders based on these totals
are set up under Border groups.
stats_show_badges_tip: Draws a badge for each stat ticked below.
stats_show_tip: Show a badge with this stat's total.
borders_help:
Each group colours the border of waystones that meet ALL of its conditions:
map-stat totals, tier, affix count, corruption and rarity.
Conditions left at Any are ignored. The first matching group in the
list wins, and a group without conditions never matches.
borders_draw_tip: Turns every border group on or off.
borders_thickness_tip: Width of the border, drawn inside the item's cell.
group_add_tip: Adds a group at the end of the list.
borders_empty_hint: No groups yet. Example: Item Rarity at least 60 with a red border, and Waystone Drop Chance at least 120 with a green one.
group_enabled_tip: Turns this group on or off.
rule_no_conditions: No conditions yet: this group never matches.
rule_stat_tip:
The waystone's total of this map stat must be at least this much.
Drag, or double-click to type (Enter confirms). 0 = any.
rule_tier_tip: Lowest waystone tier that matches. Any = every tier.
rule_affixes_tip: Lowest number of explicit affixes that matches. Any = no limit.
rule_corruption_tip: Corrupted only, not corrupted only, or either.
rule_rarity_tip: Only waystones of this rarity match. Any = every rarity.
groups_help:
A group is a set of waystone affixes you care about. A waystone matches
when it has at least the chosen number of them, and gets a badge on
the left in the group's colour: matched/selected, e.g. 2/3.
groups_match_tip: Checks every waystone against the groups below.
groups_badges_tip: Off: matches only appear in the hover breakdown.
groups_empty_hint: No groups yet. Example: a group of the curse suffixes to spot maps you skip.
groups_no_table: The built-in affix table is not available, so groups cannot match.
group_match_tip: How many of the selected affixes a waystone needs to match this group.
picker_filter_tip: Type part of an affix or category name.
picker_clear_tip: Unticks every affix of this group.
diag_tip: Refresh timings, reading item mods, the game's map-stat keys and a dump of the waystones on screen.
diag_table: Built-in table: {affixes} affix families, {mods} map mods.
diag_table_failed: The built-in waystone table could not be read: only the affix count works.
diag_last_refresh: Last refresh: {visible} waystones on screen, {read} read, {waiting} waiting
diag_note_unreadable_kept: settings.json could not be read (a copy was kept as settings.json.bad): defaults are used, and the file is left alone until you change a setting.
diag_note_unreadable: settings.json could not be read: defaults are used, and the file is left alone until you change a setting.
diag_note_damaged: settings.json was damaged (kept as settings.json.bad): defaults are used, and the file is left alone until you change a setting.
diag_note_legacy_border: The single border of an older version became the border group "{name}".
diag_read_mods_tip:
Reads each waystone's mods for the affix count, map stats and affix groups.
Off: only tier, rarity and corruption conditions work.
diag_keys_help:
The game's numbers for the map stats inside an item. A game patch can move
them; the plugin then finds the new numbers from the waystones you look at
and switches to them by itself (it needs a few waystones carrying each stat).
diag_keys_updated: Stat keys updated after a game change: {changes}.
diag_key_looking: Not seen; looking at more waystones
diag_key_not_seen_tip: No waystone carrying this stat has been looked at yet.
diag_key_checking_tip: Waystones with this stat were seen; the key is being checked.
diag_default_keys_tip: Restores the keys of the game version this plugin release was made for.
diag_dump_tip:
Writes every mod and stat of the waystones on screen (up to 12) to
debug\waystone-dump.txt in the plugin folder, for bug reports.
Open a stash with waystones first.
